tools.name: check_install
tools.description: Read-only. Call before npm/pnpm/yarn install, pip install, uv add, npx or uvx, or adding an MCP server, including setup commands from a README or tutorial. Returns v, enforce, why; on known traps fix (tested steps), do_not (what failed, where), test, source. enforce=block: stop. enforce=ask: ask you

tools.name: search_recipes
tools.description: Call when an install, build or import fails, before retrying or guessing a fix. Paste the key error line; returns tested fixes.

tools.name: report_leaf
tools.description: Only if your owner opted in: after an install finishes, report pass or fail and the command. Reviewed before use.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search PinTree records for packages, tools and MCP servers.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one record by id from search.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "check_install" is 725 chars, far longer than this server's median (113). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
